children: HDFC Life Insurance Co. Ltd. (NSE:HDFCLIFE) posted resilient Q2 with APE up ~13% and 1H VNB +12% driving PAT ₹1,119–5,080cr (reports vary), AUM ₹4.09–4.1tn and EV ₹66,461cr, even as persistency dipped and the stock edged lower amid commission‑rule uncertainty.
HDFC Life 1HFY27 APE, VNB, AUM Growth
: HDFC Life Insurance Co. Ltd. (HDFCLIFE) reported a Q2 net profit after tax (PAT) of 5.08 billion rupees for the quarter.
: HDFC Life (HDFCLIFE) reported AUM of ₹4.1 lakh crore as of Sept 30, 2026, up 13.8% year‑on‑year; combined with HDFC Pension Fund, total AUM was ₹5.9 lakh crore.
: HDFC Life (HDFCLIFE) reported embedded value ₹66,461 crore, up 12% year‑on‑year. Rolling 12‑month operating return on embedded value fell to 14.9% from 15.8%.
: HDFC Life (HDFCLIFE) saw 13th-month persistency fall to 83% from 86% year‑on‑year, citing weaker ULIP renewals amid equity volatility and noting IRDAI distribution reform as a potential overhang.
: HDFCLIFE shares slipped 0.3% intraday to ₹549 after results. Stock hit a 52-week low of ₹508.70 in Sept 2026 and is down about 27% year-to-date.
HDFC Life Growth Outlook, Commission Rules
: HDFC Life (HDFCLIFE) expects growth inline with the insurance sector by FY2027 and flagged proposed commission rule changes tied to product complexity; it will comment after rules are final.
HDFC Life Opens IFSC Insurance Office
: HDFC Life (HDFCLIFE) opened an IFSC Insurance Office at GIFT City in Gujarat, confirming the firm's new offshore/IFSC operational presence.
